title: Lulu and Velvet's Lost Pillow
markdown:
Every story starts somewhere. This one begins with a little duck who loved naps and a dusky friend who loved quiet.

Once upon a time, in a little room painted the color of sunshine and filled with soft, cuddly toys, lived a duck named Lulu. Lulu was a very fluffy duck, indeed. Her feathers were as soft and white as a brand-new cloud, and she adored napping. Oh, how she loved to nap! She’d find the softest, coziest spot, give a little wiggle of her tail feathers, and drift right off to dreamland.

In that same cozy room, but just outside the window, lived a special friend of Lulu's. This friend was a bat, but not just any bat. This was Velvet. Velvet was a bat with wings as soft and smooth as the finest, dark velvet. Velvet didn't much fancy napping in the bright sunshine; he preferred to hang upside down from his favorite, leafy branch, where he could watch the world with his big, gentle, curious eyes. Every day, Lulu would find the softest spot for a snooze, and Velvet would hang upside down from his favorite branch, enjoying the peaceful quiet and the gentle sway of the leaves.

Until one day, something quite unexpected and very lovely happened. A tiny, fluffy feather pillow, lighter than a dandelion puff and softer than a whisper, floated in through the slightly open window. It bobbed and swayed like a little boat on a calm sea, and it landed softly on Lulu’s favorite fuzzy rug. Velvet, from his leafy perch outside, saw it too. He tilted his head, his big eyes blinking. This little pillow looked a little sad, as if it had lost its way. It seemed to be waiting for someone, but nobody was there to claim it.

So, because they wanted to help, Lulu, with a soft, gentle "Quack?", waddled over to the pillow. She nudged it with her beak, feeling its incredible softness. It was just as soft as her own favorite napping spot. Velvet, with a silent flutter of his velvety wings, glided down from his branch and hovered near the window. "It seems to have lost its way home," he whispered, his voice as quiet as the rustle of autumn leaves. Lulu nodded her fluffy head in agreement. They decided right then and there, with a shared glance, that they absolutely must help this little pillow find its owner.

This made Lulu and Velvet start to look around the sunlit room. Lulu, being quite thorough, peeked under the little bed, where the dust bunnies usually hid, hoping the pillow hadn't tumbled there. Velvet, with his sharp, kind eyes, looked behind the flowery curtains, which often held forgotten toys and stray ribbons. But the little pillow just bobbed gently, swaying with every tiny breeze that whispered in from the open window. Lulu gave a small, concerned quack, her fluffy tail giving a little worried twitch.

The little pillow was drifting, ever so slowly, towards the window sill. It was almost ready to float right out, into the big, dusky evening that was just beginning to peek through the sky, painting it with soft purples and oranges. They knew if it floated away, it might never find its home again. Lulu’s fluffy tail twitched again, a little faster this time.

Until finally, Lulu had a most wonderful, gentle idea. "Let's be very, very careful," she quacked softly, her voice full of kindness. Velvet understood perfectly. With utmost care, they very, very gently nudged the pillow, guiding it away from the tempting window sill and towards the little bed where a small girl was just beginning to stir from her own nap. Her eyes blinked open, wide and sleepy, and there, right beside her, nestled amongst her blankets, was her lost, fluffy pillow! A big, joyous smile spread across her face, chasing away any lingering sleepiness. She reached out with her little arms and hugged it tight, burying her nose in its soft fluff. The pillow smelled faintly of lavender, and she could feel the tiny embroidered star on its corner. Lulu and Velvet watched from their quiet spot, their hearts feeling as warm and full as the midday sunbeam on Lulu’s favorite napping spot. It was a feeling of pure, sweet joy.

And ever since then, Lulu the fluffy duck and Velvet the gentle bat always kept a watchful eye. They knew how very important it was to help any little thing that seemed lost, for a little bit of kindness and a shared effort can always bring things back home, safe and sound. That's the curious, wonderful thing about friendship, and about helping others find their way back.
characters: Lulu the duck, Velvet the velvet bat
author: StoryGen Community
